comp.sql:
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.country,
    s.latitude,
    s.longitude,

    p.ts_vn,
    p.aqius,
    p.aqicn,
    p.mainus,
    p.maincn,
    p.p1,
    p.p2,
    p.o3,
    p.n2,
    p.s2,
    p.co,

    w.tp,
    w.pr,
    w.hu,
    w.ws,
    w.wd,
    w.ic,
    w.heat_index

FROM stations s

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM pollution_readings
    WHERE station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY COALESCE(ts_vn, ts) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) p ON true

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM weather_readings
    WHERE station_id = s.id
    ORDER BY COALESCE(ts_vn, ts) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) w ON true

ORDER BY s.id;
